cases.title: Supplier bank change and emergency payment

units.text: A supplier bank change becomes usable only after Treasury verification and independent approval by a person who did not enter the change.
The operator who entered a bank change must not approve that change.
Email confirmation alone is insufficient for Treasury verification.

documents.text:
B01: A supplier bank change becomes usable only after Treasury verification and independent approval by a person who did not enter the change.
B02: The operator who entered a bank change must not approve that change.
B03: Email confirmation alone is insufficient for Treasury verification.

units.text: During a declared payment-system outage, the treasury lead may authorise payment to the previously verified bank account.
The outage procedure does not authorise use of new unverified bank details and does not waive separation of entry and approval.
The bank-change log records operator ID and approver ID. The documents do not define a department-tenure requirement for either role.

cases.title: Milestone acceptance, partial completion and clocks

units.text: Payment requires a purchase order and signed acceptance of the billed milestone.
For services, signed milestone acceptance replaces the goods-receipt requirement only; it does not replace the purchase order.
Only the named service owner may sign acceptance; Accounts Payable may register it but may not sign it.

documents.text:

S02: For services, signed milestone acceptance replaces the goods-receipt requirement only; it does not replace the purchase order.

units.text: A disputed milestone pauses its payment clock. When the dispute resolves, the clock resumes from its prior elapsed value.
Acceptance of milestone M1 does not accept milestone M2. A dispute on M2 does not pause M1.
Before its dispute, M2 had accrued 7 payment days. The dispute has now resolved. M2 has signed acceptance but no purchase order. No payment due-day total or automatic reminder channel is specified.
